statement: A query evaluates only against a complete set of compatible read leases captured from the facade's durable safe vector; it does not assemble a result from independently sampled owner heads.

frames.note: Captures the durable safe vector before acquiring the query read cut.
Selects owner roots for the query and requests a lease cut from the captured vector.
Waits for every requested lease, releases late successes after failure, and rejects expired cuts.

consequence: A reader sees one closed subtree-vector snapshot or receives an error; it cannot observe a fractured cross-owner write.
